jobs_schedule_window_valid.name: jobs_schedule_window_valid
jobs_schedule_window_valid.value: ("jobs"."scheduled_start" IS NULL) = ("jobs"."scheduled_end" IS NULL) AND ("jobs"."scheduled_end" IS NULL OR "jobs"."scheduled_end" > "jobs"."scheduled_start")

jobs_escalation_consistent.name: jobs_escalation_consistent
jobs_escalation_consistent.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'ESCALATED') = ("jobs"."state_before_escalation" IS NOT NULL) AND "jobs"."state_before_escalation" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ESCALATED'

approvals_decision_recorded.name: approvals_decision_recorded
approvals_decision_recorded.value: "approvals"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR ("approvals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "approvals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
